content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm developing a graduation project at a university in El Salvador, using a [company_name] [product_name] (model [article_no]) for a home automation teaching system. According to the official [company_name] documentation (available in Spanish; I can share or attach the [document] if needed), my [product_name] does support connecting to Azure IoT Hub. But in [product_name] [version_no] with firmware [version_no], the field for entering the IoT Hub device name is disabled and can't be accessed. This issue is preventing me from finishing the cloud connection setup. I've installed all official updates and firmware for [company_name] products and closely followed the guide for registering the [product_name] in Azure IoT Hub, yet I still can't enable that input field. Has anyone else run into this or knows how to activate the Azure IoT Hub connection and enter the device name in [product_name]? Is there an extra license, setting, or piece of software I'm missing? Any help, advice, or links to documentation would be greatly appreciated. Thank you in advance! [user_name] from El Salvador

analysis.insight_summary: User is unable to access the Azure IoT Hub device name field when setting up a [product_name] in [product_name] [version_no] with the recommended firmware, despite following official documentation and installing updates. This inaccessible field blocks completion of the cloud connection process. The user is unsure whether licensing, extra software, or overlooked settings are responsible for the issue, and expresses frustration with the cloud integration user experience.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects the ability to fully integrate the device with Azure IoT Hub as described in the official documentation, including entering the device name as part of the setup. They want a clear, well-documented process for configuring IoT cloud connections without missing steps or hidden requirements.
feature_keywords: Azure IoT Hub device name field
